acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each row in the project list table shows a single ⋮ button instead of multiple inline buttons
Clicking ⋮ opens a dropdown with View, conditional archive/unarchive, and Delete items
Clicking a menu item outside View (archive/unarchive/delete) triggers the existing action handler
Clicking ⋮ on a second row closes the first row's dropdown
Clicking anywhere outside the open dropdown closes it
Scrolling the table closes any open dropdown
aria-expanded attribute on the trigger accurately reflects open/closed state
Delete item has distinct danger styling

summary: Replaced per-row inline action buttons (delete/archive/unarchive/view) in project-list.js buildTable() with a single kebab (⋮) trigger button opening an absolutely-positioned .action-menu dropdown.
Added closeOpenMenu()/openMenuWrapper tracking at renderProjectList scope with a once-installed document mousedown handler and per-render scroll listener on .table-wrapper.
Each .action-menu-btn gets its own click listener; opening a second menu closes the first; action handlers (delete/archive/unarchive) now call closeOpenMenu() before proceeding.
Added all required CSS rules (.action-menu-wrapper, .action-menu-btn, .action-menu, .action-menu-wrapper.is-open .action-menu, .action-menu-item, .action-menu-item.danger) to styles.css.
Delete is now always visible in the menu (regardless of project status). Archive/Unarchive rendered conditionally as before. aria-haspopup='menu' and aria-expanded wired to trigger button.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent with existing patterns.

summary: All 9 acceptance criteria verified against mcp-server/gui/public/views/project-list.js and mcp-server/gui/public/styles.css. Full test suite passes (1209/1209 tests, 41 test files). No regressions detected.

comments.note: docHandlerInstalled is closure-scoped to each renderProjectList() call. On repeated SPA navigation to the project list, each visit adds a new document mousedown handler (the prior one is never removed). Stale handlers are benign — their captured openMenuWrapper is always null after the last render reset — but accumulate across page visits. Recommend converting to a module-level singleton or storing the handler reference for removal on teardown.

No automated tests cover the kebab dropdown DOM interactions (open/close, outside-click, scroll-dismiss, aria-expanded toggling). These are all pure front-end SPA behaviors not exercised by the Vitest suite. Manual browser testing recommended; consider adding Playwright smoke tests in a future iteration.

summary: Code review of mcp-server/gui/public/views/project-list.js and mcp-server/gui/public/styles.css for the kebab action-menu feature.

ARIA attributes (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, role=menu/menuitem) correctly wired. DOM structure, toggle/mutual-exclusion logic, and closeOpenMenu() are correct. stopPropagation on trigger buttons prevents the document mousedown sentinel from immediately closing freshly opened menus.
CSS follows existing custom-property conventions; .action-menu-item.danger uses color-btn-danger-bg which is consistent with the rest of the design system.

One medium observation raised (stale document event listeners across SPA navigations); one low observation (no keyboard navigation inside open menu). Neither blocks PASS — both are in-scope for a logged follow-up.

comments.note: mcp-server/gui/public/views/project-list.js — docHandlerInstalled is closure-scoped to each renderProjectList() call. Because the SPA re-calls renderProjectList() on every navigation to the project list, each visit creates a fresh closure with docHandlerInstalled=false and registers a new document mousedown listener. QA correctly flagged this as benign (old closures capture a null openMenuWrapper) but the handlers do accumulate indefinitely. Recommend promoting docHandlerInstalled and the handler reference to module-level singletons so the listener is registered exactly once (or storing the function reference and calling removeEventListener on teardown).

mcp-server/gui/public/views/project-list.js — No keyboard event handlers inside the open .action-menu (e.g., ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move focus between items, Escape to close). The aria-haspopup/role=menu attributes imply keyboard support per WAI-ARIA Menu Button pattern. For an internal developer tool this is acceptable, but worth addressing in a future accessibility pass.

Updated styles.css file table description to include 'action menu dropdown'.

comments.note: No documentation gaps found. All new CSS classes, behaviour details (mutual exclusion, outside-click dismiss, scroll dismiss, aria attributes), and the distinction between UI visibility (delete always shown) vs backend guard (COMPLETE/ARCHIVED only) are documented in api-surface.md.
